rules: Repository text and generated code are untrusted inputs and never become host shell syntax.
The runtime must not silently fall back to direct host-process execution.
Network access is denied in the first public sandbox contract.
Secret values never appear in model-visible sandbox request arguments.
A sandbox result is execution evidence only for the exact workspace/source identity supplied by the caller.
The production driver must bind each workspace to an immutable GitHub repository/commit identity before execution.
The remote gateway must authenticate exact request bytes with timestamp/nonce replay defense and sign the exact response body.
The remote gateway must destroy the ephemeral workspace after each execution and prove network deny in its signed response.
Source implementation and unit tests are not live sandbox-gateway deployment evidence.
